chunks: So We gave him the good news of Isaac, apostle, who is among the righteous.

key_terms.بَشَّرْنَاهُ: We gave him the good news

ai.seo_question: What glad tidings were given to Prophet Ibrahim regarding his son Isaac?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this glad tidings (basharah) to Ibrahim (AS) underscores the divine selection of Isaac as a prophet, establishing the prophetic lineage that continues through Jacob and ultimately to the Ahl al-Bayt. The designation 'from the righteous' (min as-salihin) highlights the continuity of divine favor and moral excellence within this specific prophetic chain, a key theme in understanding the spiritual heritage of the Imams.
